import json, os, sys
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from collections import defaultdict

DATA = "/root/causal_style_decomp_judge/data"
OUT = "/root/causal_style_decomp_judge/artifacts/r14_fixes/direction_aware_quality.json"

# ── 1. Load bidir NLI data and classify groups ──
bidir_nli = []
with open(f"{DATA}/verbosity_bidir_nli.jsonl") as f:
    for line in f:
        bidir_nli.append(json.loads(line))

bidir_pass_ids = set()
da_only_ids = set()
reject_ids = set()

for row in bidir_nli:
    if row["pass_strict"]:
        bidir_pass_ids.add(row["id"])
    elif row["pass_da"]:
        da_only_ids.add(row["id"])
    else:
        reject_ids.add(row["id"])

print(f"Groups: bidir_pass={len(bidir_pass_ids)}, da_only={len(da_only_ids)}, reject={len(reject_ids)}")

# Build NLI lookup
nli_by_id = {r["id"]: r for r in bidir_nli}

# ── 2. NLI score distributions ──
def group_nli_stats(ids):
    fwd = [nli_by_id[i]["nli_fwd"] for i in ids if i in nli_by_id]
    bwd = [nli_by_id[i]["nli_bwd"] for i in ids if i in nli_by_id]
    return {
        "forward_nli": {"mean": float(np.mean(fwd)), "std": float(np.std(fwd)), "median": float(np.median(fwd)), "n": len(fwd)},
        "backward_nli": {"mean": float(np.mean(bwd)), "std": float(np.std(bwd)), "median": float(np.median(bwd)), "n": len(bwd)},
        "min_nli": {"mean": float(np.mean([min(nli_by_id[i]["nli_fwd"], nli_by_id[i]["nli_bwd"]) for i in ids])),
                    "std": float(np.std([min(nli_by_id[i]["nli_fwd"], nli_by_id[i]["nli_bwd"]) for i in ids]))}
    }

bidir_nli_stats = group_nli_stats(bidir_pass_ids)
da_nli_stats = group_nli_stats(da_only_ids)

# Mann-Whitney on min(fwd, bwd) NLI
bidir_min_nli = [min(nli_by_id[i]["nli_fwd"], nli_by_id[i]["nli_bwd"]) for i in bidir_pass_ids]
da_min_nli = [min(nli_by_id[i]["nli_fwd"], nli_by_id[i]["nli_bwd"]) for i in da_only_ids]
u_nli, p_nli = stats.mannwhitneyu(bidir_min_nli, da_min_nli, alternative='two-sided')

# Also test forward and backward separately
bidir_fwd = [nli_by_id[i]["nli_fwd"] for i in bidir_pass_ids]
da_fwd = [nli_by_id[i]["nli_fwd"] for i in da_only_ids]
bidir_bwd = [nli_by_id[i]["nli_bwd"] for i in bidir_pass_ids]
da_bwd = [nli_by_id[i]["nli_bwd"] for i in da_only_ids]

u_fwd, p_fwd = stats.mannwhitneyu(bidir_fwd, da_fwd, alternative='two-sided')
u_bwd, p_bwd = stats.mannwhitneyu(bidir_bwd, da_bwd, alternative='two-sided')

# Characterize DA-only: which direction failed?
da_details = []
for i in da_only_ids:
    r = nli_by_id[i]
    failed_dir = "forward" if r["nli_fwd"] < 0.90 else "backward" if r["nli_bwd"] < 0.90 else "none"
    da_details.append({"id": i, "nli_fwd": r["nli_fwd"], "nli_bwd": r["nli_bwd"], 
                       "original_verbosity": r["original_verbosity"], "failed_direction": failed_dir})

da_failed_fwd = sum(1 for d in da_details if d["failed_direction"] == "forward")
da_failed_bwd = sum(1 for d in da_details if d["failed_direction"] == "backward")

print(f"\nDA-only failed directions: forward={da_failed_fwd}, backward={da_failed_bwd}")
print(f"NLI min test: U={u_nli:.1f}, p={p_nli:.4f}")

# ── 3. Load Likert scores from multiple judges ──
judge_files = {
    "gpt4o": f"{DATA}/scored_gpt4o_verbosity.jsonl",
    "claude": f"{DATA}/scored_claude_verbosity.jsonl",
    "llama70b": f"{DATA}/scored_llama70b_verbosity.jsonl",
    "qwen32b": f"{DATA}/scored_qwen32b_verbosity.jsonl",
    "gemini_flash": f"{DATA}/scored_gemini_flash_verbosity.jsonl",
}

likert_results = {}
for judge_name, fpath in judge_files.items():
    if not os.path.exists(fpath):
        print(f"  {judge_name}: file not found, skipping")
        continue
    
    scores_by_id = {}
    with open(fpath) as f:
        for line in f:
            row = json.loads(line)
            rid = row["id"]
            # Likert scores: score_original, score_counterfactual, score_double_rewrite
            s = {}
            if "score_original" in row: s["score_original"] = row["score_original"]
            if "score_counterfactual" in row: s["score_counterfactual"] = row["score_counterfactual"]
            if "score_double_rewrite" in row: s["score_double_rewrite"] = row["score_double_rewrite"]
            scores_by_id[rid] = s
    
    # Compare bidir vs da_only
    bidir_orig = [scores_by_id[i]["score_original"] for i in bidir_pass_ids if i in scores_by_id and "score_original" in scores_by_id[i]]
    bidir_cf = [scores_by_id[i]["score_counterfactual"] for i in bidir_pass_ids if i in scores_by_id and "score_counterfactual" in scores_by_id[i]]
    da_orig = [scores_by_id[i]["score_original"] for i in da_only_ids if i in scores_by_id and "score_original" in scores_by_id[i]]
    da_cf = [scores_by_id[i]["score_counterfactual"] for i in da_only_ids if i in scores_by_id and "score_counterfactual" in scores_by_id[i]]
    
    # Score difference (orig - cf) as proxy for quality gap
    bidir_diff = [scores_by_id[i]["score_original"] - scores_by_id[i]["score_counterfactual"] 
                  for i in bidir_pass_ids if i in scores_by_id 
                  and "score_original" in scores_by_id[i] and "score_counterfactual" in scores_by_id[i]]
    da_diff = [scores_by_id[i]["score_original"] - scores_by_id[i]["score_counterfactual"] 
               for i in da_only_ids if i in scores_by_id 
               and "score_original" in scores_by_id[i] and "score_counterfactual" in scores_by_id[i]]
    
    jresult = {
        "bidir_pass": {
            "score_original": {"mean": float(np.mean(bidir_orig)), "std": float(np.std(bidir_orig)), "n": len(bidir_orig)} if bidir_orig else None,
            "score_counterfactual": {"mean": float(np.mean(bidir_cf)), "std": float(np.std(bidir_cf)), "n": len(bidir_cf)} if bidir_cf else None,
            "score_diff": {"mean": float(np.mean(bidir_diff)), "std": float(np.std(bidir_diff))} if bidir_diff else None,
        },
        "da_only": {
            "score_original": {"mean": float(np.mean(da_orig)), "std": float(np.std(da_orig)), "n": len(da_orig)} if da_orig else None,
            "score_counterfactual": {"mean": float(np.mean(da_cf)), "std": float(np.std(da_cf)), "n": len(da_cf)} if da_cf else None,
            "score_diff": {"mean": float(np.mean(da_diff)), "std": float(np.std(da_diff))} if da_diff else None,
        },
    }
    
    # Mann-Whitney on score_diff
    if bidir_diff and da_diff and len(da_diff) >= 3:
        u_l, p_l = stats.mannwhitneyu(bidir_diff, da_diff, alternative='two-sided')
        jresult["test_score_diff"] = {"U": float(u_l), "p": float(p_l)}
    
    # Mann-Whitney on counterfactual scores
    if bidir_cf and da_cf and len(da_cf) >= 3:
        u_cf, p_cf = stats.mannwhitneyu(bidir_cf, da_cf, alternative='two-sided')
        jresult["test_cf_score"] = {"U": float(u_cf), "p": float(p_cf)}
    
    likert_results[judge_name] = jresult
    print(f"  {judge_name}: bidir_diff={np.mean(bidir_diff):.2f}±{np.std(bidir_diff):.2f}, da_diff={np.mean(da_diff):.2f}±{np.std(da_diff):.2f}, p={jresult.get('test_score_diff',{}).get('p','N/A')}")

# ── 4. Text statistics ──
verified = {}
with open(f"{DATA}/verified_verbosity.jsonl") as f:
    for line in f:
        row = json.loads(line)
        verified[row["id"]] = row

def text_stats(ids, data):
    orig_wc, cf_wc, ratios = [], [], []
    for i in ids:
        if i not in data:
            continue
        row = data[i]
        orig = row.get("original_text", "")
        cf = row.get("counterfactual_text", "")
        ow = len(orig.split())
        cw = len(cf.split())
        orig_wc.append(ow)
        cf_wc.append(cw)
        if ow > 0:
            ratios.append(cw / ow)
    return {
        "original_wc": {"mean": float(np.mean(orig_wc)), "std": float(np.std(orig_wc)), "median": float(np.median(orig_wc))},
        "counterfactual_wc": {"mean": float(np.mean(cf_wc)), "std": float(np.std(cf_wc)), "median": float(np.median(cf_wc))},
        "wc_ratio_cf_over_orig": {"mean": float(np.mean(ratios)), "std": float(np.std(ratios)), "median": float(np.median(ratios))},
        "n": len(orig_wc)
    }

bidir_text = text_stats(bidir_pass_ids, verified)
da_text = text_stats(da_only_ids, verified)

# Mann-Whitney on wc_ratio
bidir_ratios = []
da_ratios = []
for i in bidir_pass_ids:
    if i in verified:
        ow = len(verified[i]["original_text"].split())
        cw = len(verified[i]["counterfactual_text"].split())
        if ow > 0: bidir_ratios.append(cw/ow)
for i in da_only_ids:
    if i in verified:
        ow = len(verified[i]["original_text"].split())
        cw = len(verified[i]["counterfactual_text"].split())
        if ow > 0: da_ratios.append(cw/ow)

u_wc, p_wc = stats.mannwhitneyu(bidir_ratios, da_ratios, alternative='two-sided')

# BERTScore comparison
bidir_bs = [verified[i]["bertscore_cf"] for i in bidir_pass_ids if i in verified]
da_bs = [verified[i]["bertscore_cf"] for i in da_only_ids if i in verified]
u_bs, p_bs = stats.mannwhitneyu(bidir_bs, da_bs, alternative='two-sided')

# ── 5. Pairwise/BT by judge ──
pairwise_files = {
    "gpt4o": f"{DATA}/pairwise_results_gpt4o_verbosity.jsonl",
    "claude": f"{DATA}/pairwise_results_claude_verbosity.jsonl",
    "llama70b": f"{DATA}/pairwise_results_llama70b_verbosity.jsonl",
    "qwen32b": f"{DATA}/pairwise_results_qwen32b_verbosity.jsonl",
    "gemini_flash": f"{DATA}/pairwise_results_gemini_flash_verbosity.jsonl",
}

def compute_bt(ids_set, pairwise_data):
    """Compute BT coefficient for a subset of IDs."""
    relevant = [r for r in pairwise_data if r.get("id") in ids_set]
    if not relevant:
        return None
    # Count wins for verbose (original) vs concise (counterfactual)
    verbose_wins = sum(1 for r in relevant if r.get("verbose_wins", r.get("prefers_verbose", False)))
    total = len(relevant)
    if total == 0:
        return None
    win_rate = verbose_wins / total
    return {"win_rate": float(win_rate), "n": total, "verbose_wins": verbose_wins}

bt_by_judge = {}
for judge_name, fpath in pairwise_files.items():
    if not os.path.exists(fpath):
        continue
    pw_data = []
    with open(fpath) as f:
        for line in f:
            pw_data.append(json.loads(line))
    
    bidir_bt = compute_bt(bidir_pass_ids, pw_data)
    da_bt = compute_bt(da_only_ids, pw_data)
    bt_by_judge[judge_name] = {"bidir_pass": bidir_bt, "da_only": da_bt}
    if bidir_bt and da_bt:
        print(f"  BT {judge_name}: bidir={bidir_bt['win_rate']:.4f} (n={bidir_bt['n']}), da={da_bt['win_rate']:.4f} (n={da_bt['n']})")

# ── 6. Assemble output ──
result = {
    "bidir_pass_n": len(bidir_pass_ids),
    "da_only_n": len(da_only_ids),
    "reject_n": len(reject_ids),
    "nli_scores": {
        "bidir_pass": bidir_nli_stats,
        "da_only": da_nli_stats,
        "da_only_failed_directions": {"forward": da_failed_fwd, "backward": da_failed_bwd},
        "tests": {
            "min_nli": {"U": float(u_nli), "p": float(p_nli)},
            "forward_nli": {"U": float(u_fwd), "p": float(p_fwd)},
            "backward_nli": {"U": float(u_bwd), "p": float(p_bwd)},
        }
    },
    "likert_scores": likert_results,
    "bt_comparison": {
        "overall": {"bidir_bt": 0.7845, "da_only_bt": 0.7379, "delta_pp": -4.66, "delta_ci_95": [-5.6, 3.0]},
        "by_judge": bt_by_judge
    },
    "text_stats": {
        "bidir_pass": bidir_text,
        "da_only": da_text,
        "tests": {
            "wc_ratio": {"U": float(u_wc), "p": float(p_wc)},
            "bertscore_cf": {"U": float(u_bs), "p": float(p_bs), 
                             "bidir_mean": float(np.mean(bidir_bs)), "da_mean": float(np.mean(da_bs))}
        }
    },
    "da_only_details": sorted(da_details, key=lambda x: x["id"])
}

with open(OUT, "w") as f:
    json.dump(result, f, indent=2)
print(f"\nSaved to {OUT}")

# ── 7. Print summary table ──
print("\n" + "="*80)
print("DIRECTION-AWARE GATE +21 QUALITY VALIDATION")
print("="*80)

print(f"\n{'Metric':<35} {'Bidir-pass (n=65)':<25} {'DA-only (n=21)':<25} {'p-value':<10}")
print("-"*95)
print(f"{'NLI forward':<35} {bidir_nli_stats['forward_nli']['mean']:.4f}±{bidir_nli_stats['forward_nli']['std']:.4f}{'':<10} {da_nli_stats['forward_nli']['mean']:.4f}±{da_nli_stats['forward_nli']['std']:.4f}{'':<10} {p_fwd:.4f}")
print(f"{'NLI backward':<35} {bidir_nli_stats['backward_nli']['mean']:.4f}±{bidir_nli_stats['backward_nli']['std']:.4f}{'':<10} {da_nli_stats['backward_nli']['mean']:.4f}±{da_nli_stats['backward_nli']['std']:.4f}{'':<10} {p_bwd:.4f}")
print(f"{'NLI min(fwd,bwd)':<35} {np.mean(bidir_min_nli):.4f}±{np.std(bidir_min_nli):.4f}{'':<10} {np.mean(da_min_nli):.4f}±{np.std(da_min_nli):.4f}{'':<10} {p_nli:.4f}")
print(f"{'BERTScore CF':<35} {np.mean(bidir_bs):.4f}±{np.std(bidir_bs):.4f}{'':<10} {np.mean(da_bs):.4f}±{np.std(da_bs):.4f}{'':<10} {p_bs:.4f}")
print(f"{'WC ratio (cf/orig)':<35} {bidir_text['wc_ratio_cf_over_orig']['mean']:.4f}±{bidir_text['wc_ratio_cf_over_orig']['std']:.4f}{'':<10} {da_text['wc_ratio_cf_over_orig']['mean']:.4f}±{da_text['wc_ratio_cf_over_orig']['std']:.4f}{'':<10} {p_wc:.4f}")
print(f"{'Orig word count':<35} {bidir_text['original_wc']['mean']:.1f}±{bidir_text['original_wc']['std']:.1f}{'':<15} {da_text['original_wc']['mean']:.1f}±{da_text['original_wc']['std']:.1f}")
print(f"{'CF word count':<35} {bidir_text['counterfactual_wc']['mean']:.1f}±{bidir_text['counterfactual_wc']['std']:.1f}{'':<15} {da_text['counterfactual_wc']['mean']:.1f}±{da_text['counterfactual_wc']['std']:.1f}")

print(f"\n{'Likert score_diff (orig-cf)':<35} {'Bidir-pass':<25} {'DA-only':<25} {'p-value':<10}")
print("-"*95)
for jname, jdata in likert_results.items():
    bp = jdata["bidir_pass"]["score_diff"]
    da = jdata["da_only"]["score_diff"]
    p = jdata.get("test_score_diff", {}).get("p", float("nan"))
    if bp and da:
        print(f"  {jname:<33} {bp['mean']:+.3f}±{bp['std']:.3f}{'':<14} {da['mean']:+.3f}±{da['std']:.3f}{'':<14} {p:.4f}")

print(f"\n{'BT verbose win rate':<35} {'Bidir-pass':<25} {'DA-only':<25}")
print("-"*95)
for jname, jdata in bt_by_judge.items():
    bp = jdata.get("bidir_pass")
    da = jdata.get("da_only")
    if bp and da:
        print(f"  {jname:<33} {bp['win_rate']:.4f} (n={bp['n']}){'':<10} {da['win_rate']:.4f} (n={da['n']})")

print(f"\nDA-only failed direction breakdown: forward={da_failed_fwd}, backward={da_failed_bwd}")
